# Closed-world check of the claim "the mouse shouts at the beetle" (submitted answer: proved).
# Standard library only. Exhaustive over the one unstated quantity (walrus money).

FACTS = {
    ("negotiates", "ant", "stork"),
    ("acquires_photo", "dragon", "fish"),
    ("hides_from", "mannikin", "liger"),
    ("located_in", "mouse", "Nigeria"),
    ("neglects", "worm", "chihuahua"),
    ("not_surrender", "crow", "wolf"),
    ("not_trade", "dalmatian", "stork"),
}
STORK_MONEY = 98
CONTINENT = {"Nigeria": "Africa"}


def has(*fact):
    return fact in FACTS


def derive(walrus_money):
    """walrus_money: int, or None when the state does not state it (closed world: unknown)."""
    # Rule1: ant negotiates with stork AND dalmatian does not trade with stork -> stork builds.
    rule1 = has("negotiates", "ant", "stork") and has("not_trade", "dalmatian", "stork")
    # Rule3: stork has more money than walrus -> stork does NOT build. Rule3 preferred over Rule1.
    rule3 = walrus_money is not None and STORK_MONEY > walrus_money
    stork_builds = rule1 and not rule3

    # Rule4: mouse in Africa -> smiles at cobra. Rule7 (agriculture) preferred over Rule4; no agriculture fact.
    mouse_in_africa = CONTINENT.get("Nigeria") == "Africa" and has("located_in", "mouse", "Nigeria")
    mouse_smiles_cobra = mouse_in_africa  # Rule7 never fires: no agriculture fact.

    # Rule5: hugs dinosaur AND smiles at cobra -> shouts at beetle.
    # No fact and no rule concludes "hugs dinosaur", so this antecedent is never satisfiable.
    hugs_dinosaur_derivable = any(f[0] == "hugs_dinosaur" and f[1] == "mouse" for f in FACTS)
    shout_derivable = hugs_dinosaur_derivable and mouse_smiles_cobra

    # Rule2: some animal builds a plant -> mouse does NOT shout at beetle (Rule5 preferred over Rule2).
    if shout_derivable:
        return "proved"
    if stork_builds:
        return "disproved"
    return "unknown"


print("hugs_dinosaur derivable for mouse:", any(f[0] == "hugs_dinosaur" for f in FACTS))
print("stork builds (walrus money unknown):", (has("negotiates", "ant", "stork")
      and has("not_trade", "dalmatian", "stork")))

# Exhaustive sweep over walrus money: None (unstated) plus 0..1000.
domain = [None] + list(range(0, 1001))
results = {}
for w in domain:
    r = derive(w)
    results[r] = results.get(r, 0) + 1
print("outcomes over walrus-money domain:", results)

baseline = derive(None)
print("closed-world verdict:", baseline)

claimed = "proved"
if "proved" in results:
    print("CHECK UNKNOWN: some walrus value yields a proof; claim needs review")
elif claimed == baseline:
    print("CHECK PASS")
else:
    print("CHECK FAIL: claimed", claimed, "but derived", baseline)
